app.title: FloodPath-Care
app.subtitle: Flood-aware emergency routing to maternal facilities
banner.simulation: Historical-data-informed simulation. Ambulance data is simulated. Not for live dispatch.
kpi.changed_runs: reachability changed in at least one run
card.top_origins: Origins with the largest travel-time increase
label.placeholder_weights: Population weights are placeholders (ward population not loaded). Coverage is a share of sample points, not of people.
result.unreachable: No suitable facility is reachable under this scenario.
note.indicative: Indicative ranking. Estimated people assume an even spread within each ward. Scenarios are not predictions. Not an operational dispatch order.
gap.facility_list: No public verified list of emergency obstetric facilities with coordinates exists for Chennai. The facility list is a hand-checked proxy.
gap.ambulance: No 108 ambulance data is public. Ambulance starts and times are simulated.
gap.peak: No open flood extent exists for the 1-4 Dec 2015 peak. The observed scenario is a composite of available layers.
gap.roads: Roads are current OpenStreetMap roads, not 2015 roads.
expl.baseline_blocked: The conventional route to {baseline_facility} crosses {n_blocked} blocked road segment(s) under the {scenario} scenario, so it is not drivable.
expl.reachable_longer: The nearest reachable facility offering {service} is {facility}, {time} minutes away, {delta} minutes longer than the conventional route.
expl.reachable_shorter: The nearest reachable facility offering {service} is {facility}, {time} minutes away, {delta} minutes shorter than the conventional route.
expl.unreachable_all: No suitable facility is reachable from this origin under the {scenario} scenario.
app.skeleton_notice: Preview skeleton: layout only, no data yet.
page.route.title: Route explorer
map.error: Map data could not be loaded. Run python scripts/build_phase2.py.
map.tiles_note: Basemap labels stay in the map provider's language.
map.attribution: Flood layers: OpenCity (Oorvani Foundation), Greater Chennai Corporation, NRSC. Roads: OpenStreetMap contributors.
map.roads_note: Roads are today's roads, not 2015 roads.
kpi.not_routed: The observed layer is a map composite and is not routed on. Choose mild, moderate or severe.
kpi.note_time_none: no origin has both a drivable conventional route and a flood-aware route
kpi.note_feasibility: of conventional routes cross a blocked road
kpi.note_robust: {pct} changed their facility in at least one run ({runs} runs)
chart.no_origins: No origin has a flood-aware route.
state.metrics_missing: Metrics file not found. Run python scripts/build_metrics.py.
note.indicative_metrics: Indicative simulation results on a proxy facility list and simulated origins; not predictions.
expl.reachable_same: The nearest reachable facility offering {service} is {facility}, {time} minutes away, the same as the conventional route.
reason.NO_PATH_AFTER_FLOODING: no road path remains after flooding
reason.ORIGIN_CUT_OFF: the start point is cut off
state.routes_missing: Route file not found. Run python scripts/build_routes.py.
state.audit_missing: Audit file not found. Run python scripts/build_audit.py.
route.audit_hint: The log lists the selection, every assumption in effect, datasets, flood layer, facilities, result, metrics and limits. It is a JSON file in English.
iso.units_note: Zones are 1 km grid cells because ward boundaries and populations were not loaded. Every zone has the same placeholder weight, so the ranking follows the share of road nodes cut off, not people.
iso.excluded_baseline: {n} road nodes are excluded because they cannot reach any facility even without flooding.
iso.limit1: Node share is a proxy for streets and area, not for people; a single dead-end node counts as one node.
iso.limit2: Population is not loaded, so every zone has the same placeholder weight.
iso.limit3: Scenarios are simulated subsets of flood reports; the ranking is not a forecast.
iso.limit4: Nodes already disconnected without flooding are excluded, so very poorly connected areas may be under-reported.
iso.limit5: Rankings change between scenarios, and the comparison above shows the change.
metrics.title: Metrics by scenario
metrics.m2_false: Conventional routes crossing a blocked road
metrics.m3_any: Origins reaching at least one facility
metrics.m5_changed: Origins whose facility changed in at least one run
metrics.note: Sample of {n} simulated origins, {runs} robustness runs. Coverage is a share of sample points, not of people. Indicative simulation, not a prediction.
export.intro: Files use English column names and include the interface language. They describe simulation results, not predictions.
export.audit_json: Audit log for the current scenario and the chosen start (JSON)
export.not_available: Not available for the observed composite: choose a simulated scenario.
export.failed: The file could not be created. Run the build scripts listed in the README.
iso.units_note_wards: Units are Chennai's 155 wards (2008 boundaries) clipped to the study zone. Populations are Census 2011, assumed evenly spread inside each ward and scaled to the part of the ward inside the zone. Estimates are indicative.
iso.limit2_wards: Population is Census 2011 (old), assumed evenly spread inside each ward; it is not where people are during a flood.
iso.basis_census: Census 2011, scaled to the study zone
metrics.note_weighted: Sample of {n} simulated origins, {runs} robustness runs. Coverage weights each origin by the Census 2011 population of its ward (scaled to the study zone), so it is an indicative share of people in the sample wards, not of the whole city. Not a prediction.
kpi.note_robust_na: not defined for the observed composite (one fixed layer)
metrics.m3_ci: Origins reaching at least one facility, 90% range
